name: default
about: The output format the models are asked for. brief.py renders it into the brief, run_round.py maps each reply by these keys, and the review site shows the fields in this order.
To change the format, edit this file, or copy it to formats/<new-name>.json and pass --format <new-name>. No code change is needed.
Placeholders: <<PREMISE_HINT>> becomes the slot hint from brief.py, <<MAX_CHARS>> becomes the outline ceiling drawn for the slot.
body_field names the field holding the outline itself. Fields that are not Candidate attributes are kept in candidate.extra.
show tells the review site where a field goes: title, kind, cast, location, nearest, body, note (listed under the outline with its label), or hidden.
Bump version whenever the wording or the field list changes, so rounds generated under different formats can be told apart.
label_en is the English label on the review site. Like label and show it is display only and never reaches the brief, so changing it needs no version bump.
intro: 输出一个 JSON 对象，字段如下：
outro: 只输出这一个 JSON 对象，不要输出任何其他文字。

fields.instruction: 出场角色的 slug 列表。
场景文件名，从上面的场景清单里挑最合适的一个。**地点由故事决定，不要为了用某个地点而编故事。**
下面已有故事里与这篇**同类**的那一篇（slug）。
这篇凭什么配站在那一篇旁边——它带来了那一篇没有的什么。**要求的是"配得上"，不是"比它小"：不要用更平淡、更安静、更少人物来制造区别。**
fields.label: 比照

fields.instruction: 这个故事之后留下的、改不回去的那个东西。
fields.label: 残留

fields.instruction: **只统计新的客串角色或新的场景**，两者都没有就填 `"none"`。新的情节、道具、笑点、以及关于现有角色的新事实都**不算**——那些是正常创作。
fields.label: 新元素

fields.instruction: 故事大纲，**不超过 <<MAX_CHARS>> 字**。不是正文，不要写对白和场面。
